name: Santa Clara County Sheriff's Office Youth Cadet Program
org: County of Santa Clara Office of the Sheriff
what_you_do: Learn about police and jail work by going on patrol ride-alongs, helping at crime prevention fairs and events, and touring jails and courts. You also train in first aid, CPR, and patrol basics.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 20 and a half. If you are under 18 you must be in high school with at least a 2.0 GPA. No extensive or serious criminal history, and you must be in good physical shape.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer program. Cadets who attend the summer academy get college credit.
duration: Meetings twice a month on alternating Thursday evenings (3 hours each), at least 8 volunteer hours a month, and a 3-week summer academy.
deadline_text: The page does not list application dates or a deadline.
how_to_apply: The page does not explain how to apply or link a form. Contact the Santa Clara County Sheriff's Office to ask about the next cadet class.
notes: Meetings are required. Cadets can choose to act as decoys in alcohol and tobacco sting operations. You must commit to the full 3-week summer academy.
